notes.title: Version 12.4
notes.notes:
Hello! I thought just recently that I had moved on from this game for good and wouldn't be making any more patches. But the nature of this project has always been to keep coming back after I think it's finally finished. (Really--long ago I said the game was finished when there was only Classic Mode.)

I've just recently finished [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717770/The_Upturned/]The Upturned[/url], a physics-based platformer with some very huge, complex scenes, and that taught me a lot of tricks to increase performance. So with this patch the game runs at least twice as fast. Hooray! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198702/339117a40a547316cebf8cd11813b1eefcde94cd.png[/img]

You can follow me on twitter @ZeekerssRBLX. You're also welcome to chat on our discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/jKuCvk6][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198702/59922b91a95a18f94a4b2c5dd98b40eba562f891.png[/img][/url]

I've also just started a patreon, so if you'd like to support me and get a look at what I'm currently working on...
[url=https://www.patreon.com/bePatron?u=73320341][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198702/7eac34b7d1b8304818fc715c09612be26e199e61.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch - Version 12.3c
notes.notes:
Hi! I can't believe it's almost been one year since the first version of It Steals was released for free and then slowly grew into a full thing. Anyway I'm here for a quick update to improve the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198702/62a1eae7d0e985cde27731017af63759b094828d.png[/img]

Also, I'm working on something new called Dead Seater, as well as my massive text adventure Welcome To The Dark Place. If you'd like to stay updated, you can follow me on twitter @ZeekerssRBLX. I also have a discord where we sit in silence and wait for me to do something (but also people are quite nice and post updates on their own projects here from time to time):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38198702/59922b91a95a18f94a4b2c5dd98b40eba562f891.png[/img]

Legs used to throw tantrums on unsuspecting players. Here is rare footage, just for the record. If this happened to you, Legs sincerely apologizes. https://youtu.be/AEt_J3H54Mo

notes.title: Patch - Version 12.2

This is a quick patch while I continue to work on my main project, Welcome To The Dark Place.

[b]If you have any ideas for secret star modes, please send them my way![/b] I am trying to think of ways to remix the base game modes to make them more challenging in interesting new ways. (So, not just tweaking the numbers to make it more difficult.)
